selection: Select whole frames or objects, then move or resize them. Use this for arranging the page without editing individual path points.
directSelection: Select an individual anchor or segment inside a path. Use this when the shape itself needs adjustment.
page: Select and adjust a page rather than a frame on it. Use this for page-level geometry changes.
gap: Adjust the space between neighboring frames. Use this when the gutter between objects needs to change.
contentCollector: Collect selected content for reuse. Use the content conveyor to gather items before placing them elsewhere.
contentPlacer: Place content from the content conveyor. Use this after collecting items that you want to reuse in another position.
type: Create a text frame or edit text inside one. Click within existing text to place the insertion point.
typeOnPath: Place and edit text that follows a path. Use an existing path as the text baseline.
verticalType: Create or edit vertically arranged text. Use this when a layout needs vertical text flow.
verticalTypeOnPath: Arrange vertical text along a path. Select the path you want the text to follow.
line: Draw a straight line segment. Use the stroke controls to change its appearance.
pen: Build a precise path point by point. Click for corners and drag when creating curved segments.
addAnchor: Add an anchor to an existing path. Add points only where you need more control over the outline.
deleteAnchor: Remove an anchor from an existing path. Use this to simplify an outline without deleting the entire object.
convertDirection: Change how a path passes through an anchor. Use direction handles to adjust a corner or curve.
pencil: Draw a freehand path. Use this for organic outlines rather than point-by-point construction.
smooth: Reduce irregularities along a path. Work over an existing outline to make its curve smoother.
erase: Erase part of an existing path. Use this for removing unwanted sections rather than deleting the whole object.
rectangleFrame: Draw a rectangular frame intended to hold placed content. Use it as a placeholder before placing an image.
ellipseFrame: Draw an elliptical content frame. Use it for an oval image crop or placeholder.
polygonFrame: Draw a polygonal content frame. Use it when placed artwork needs a polygon-shaped boundary.
rectangle: Draw a rectangular shape. Apply a fill, stroke or both for backgrounds, borders and graphic elements.
ellipse: Draw an elliptical shape. Use it for circles, badges and other rounded page elements.
polygon: Draw a polygonal shape. Adjust its shape settings for the number of sides you need.
scissors: Split a path at a chosen point. Use this to turn a continuous outline into separate segments.
freeTransform: Transform a selected object using its bounding controls. Use it for interactive size and orientation adjustments.
rotate: Rotate a selected object around a reference point. Use this when its angle needs to change.
scale: Resize selected content. Check whether you want proportional scaling before committing a size change.
shear: Slant selected content. Use this for an angled shape while keeping its opposite sides parallel.
gradientSwatch: Control a gradient's direction and span on an object. Choose gradient colors in the associated color controls.
gradientFeather: Apply or adjust a gradual fade in transparency. Use this when content should blend softly into the page.
note: Add an editorial note. Use notes for instructions or review comments separate from the visible page artwork.
colorTheme: Collect a color theme from artwork. Use the resulting colors to build a consistent page palette.
eyedropper: Sample appearance attributes from existing artwork. Use it to repeat an established visual style.
measure: Measure a distance or angle between points. Use it to inspect geometry before adjusting your layout.
hand: Pan the document view. Moving the view does not move page objects.
zoom: Change the view magnification. Zooming changes how closely you inspect the page, not its output dimensions.
